en.headline: Hong Kong Economic Journal founder Lam Hang-chi dies at 86
en.dek: The newspaper said Lam Shan-muk, who wrote under the pen name Lam Hang-chi, died on 6 September; Richard Li called him a respected figure in the city’s press.
body: Lam Hang-chi, founder of the Hong Kong Economic Journal and a long-serving commentator on politics and the economy, has died at the age of 86, the newspaper reported on Thursday.

The Journal said Lam, whose given name was Lam Shan-muk, died on 6 September in the company of his family. The death was announced on 10 September. Born in 1940 in the Chaozhou area of Guangdong, he worked at Ming Pao in the 1960s, later studied economics in Britain, and in 1973 co-founded the Journal with his wife, Lok Yau-mui, and journalist Lo Chi-ping. He launched the Hong Kong Economic Journal Monthly in 1977.

From 1973 to 1996 he wrote a daily editorial known as Political and Economic Notes, then continued a signed column until he laid down his pen in July 2021 after more than 48 years at the paper. Readers and peers often called him one of Hong Kong’s most distinctive newspaper voices. He was appointed OBE in 1991. In 2006 he sold a stake in the Journal to Richard Li; Li acquired the remainder in 2014.

Li said in a statement that he was deeply saddened by Lam’s death and offered condolences to the family. He described Lam as a respected figure in Hong Kong journalism who founded the Journal on a clear professional idea and left a body of closely argued commentary that would be remembered.

zh.headline: 《信報》創辦人林行止逝世 享年86歲
zh.dek: 報社周四公布，原名林山木的林行止於9月6日在家人陪同下離世；電訊盈科主席李澤楷發聲明致哀。
body: 《信報財經新聞》創辦人林行止日前逝世，享年86歲。報社周四報道，原名林山木的林行止於9月6日在家人陪同下離世，死訊於10日公布。
林行止1940年出生於廣東潮州澄海一帶，1960年代曾於《明報》工作，其後赴英國修讀經潟學。1973年與妻子騖友梅及傳媒人羅治平創辦《信報》，1977年再創辦《信報財經月刊》。1973年至1996年他每日撰寫社論《政經短評》，其後改寫《林行止專欄》，直至2021年7月撥筆，在報社工作逾48年。他1991年獲頒OBE勳衔。
林行止2006年出售《信報》部分股權予李澤楷，2014年售出餘下股份。李澤楷發表聲明，對林行止辭世深感哀痛，並向其家人致以慰問。他形容林行止是香港新聞界備受尊崇的代表人物，以清晰而嚴謹的專業理念創辦《信報》，一生筆耕不緙，留下大量具深度的評論文稿。
